outcome: Doppler indices (Resistance Index, Pulsatility Index) of uterine arteries
cohort: 100 pregnant women, consisting of 50 with threatened preterm labor (study group) and 50 healthy controls, all of similar gestational age.
finding: Rectal progesterone therapy significantly reduced the resistance index and pulsatility index of uterine arteries in women with threatened preterm labor, suggesting it can help arrest preterm labor.
followup_time: Doppler measurements were taken 1 week after starting rectal progesterone therapy, and delivery timing was followed until term.
gest_age: Participants were of similar gestational age between groups; specific range not provided.
